title: Final Practicum (Elementary Post-Degree)
description: Full time final practicum experience in BC Ministry of Education approved school. Focussed on effective demonstration of the Professional Standards for BC Educators.
notes: Credit will be granted for only one of ED-P 461, ED-P 400A, ED-P 400B, ED-P 400C, ED-P 400D, IED 461.
Normally takes place in the fall term.
